Coke Studio Season 11| Episode 5
Song Name: Malang
Much like the name suggests this love song, , raves about passion as the ultimate expression of love. Sahir Ali Bagga and Aima Baig's powerful energy give a whole new dimension to the momentum at play. Coke Studio is ready to bring you upbeat songs and the best of 2018 songs. The orchestral build-up sways with the vocal harmonies and it's arrangement.
